summary: Verified per-bot isolation of the Historial tab (bug fix) plus trade detail dialog, mini chart, note editor and filters on Bybit, HotForex and Pepperstone. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (trade lists isolated per router, detail/candles/note per bot, cross-bot ids return 404). UI: each bot shows only its own trades (Bybit ETHUSDT+BTCUSDT, HotForex EURUSD+XAUUSD, Pepperstone GBPUSD), including right after switching bots with 'Cambiar bot' (no stale list, even 300ms after the tab opens). All detail/candles/note requests go to the correct base (/api, /api/fx, /api/pepper). Charts load: XAUUSD 'velas 5m · 128', GBPUSD 'velas 5m · 110', BTCUSDT 'velas 5m · 97'. Saving a note on the FX trade shows the 'Nota guardada' toast and the note icon, and the note persists on /api/fx; /api/trades/{fxId} returns 404. Filters work: Take Profit gives '1 de 2', searching 'limpia' shows only BTCUSDT, Clear brings back 2 rows. The BTCUSDT 'Señal de origen' section is present. Closing the dialog with Escape or the X button does not crash the page. No console errors.

design_issues.screen: Trade detail mini chart (FX seeded trades)
issues: Seeded XAUUSD (entry 2650) and GBPUSD (entry 1.27) prices are far from the real Yahoo candles (~4000 / ~1.34), so the entry/exit/SL price lines sit off the visible chart. This comes from the seed data, not a code bug, but real trades will look fine.

critical_code_review_comments: TradeHistory: http.get('/trades?limit=500').catch(() => {}) swallows errors silently and falls back to the `trades` prop with no error state.
Candles and trades requests fire twice per open because of React.StrictMode double effects in dev only. Harmless.

setApiBase() runs during render in Dashboard/FxDashboard and mutates a global axios client. It works now, but it is fragile if two dashboards ever mount together (for example during a route transition with a pending request).
